answer: Commit a hash of the work, reveal the text after the epoch closes, then let peers grade what was revealed. Disagreement dilutes the reward instead of voiding it, so a random grader loses share while consistent ones keep theirs. Rewards vest over a hundred epochs. An attacker building a haven of clones on one knoll of rented infrastructure must fund them through the full vest, and duplicates surface at reveal because identical text hashes identically. The sonnet template is caught on the first pass.
